description: SCR 1004 sponsor Sen. Wendy Rogers (R-LD7) closed committee testimony with a sharp warning about what she called misleading public safety claims. Sen. Rogers opened her closing by referencing “How to lie with statistics,” then cited Scottsdale crash numbers as an example of why she disputes the argument that photo radar improves roadway safety: 2020:
title: SCR 1004 | Sen. Wendy Rogers’ Closing Remarks | January 20, 2026 | Wendy Rogers
